description: A PHP template file used for editing blog posts within an admin interface. It includes form rendering, JavaScript integration for a rich text editor (CKEditor), and handles post data validation and population.

classes.name: Model\Blog\Post
classes.description: Represents a blog post object, with properties such as id, title, text, media, tags, gallery, date, allow, and publish.
